hindi: इसलिए इसका नाम सोमवार पड़ा है।
says: Because the Moon is soma-rasa, the weekday took the name Somvar.

gist: Rhetorical: what is soma-rasa.

hindi: अमृत इंद्र की सभा में अमृत पिया जाता है।
says: Soma-rasa is amrita, nectar drunk in Indra's court.
classical_check: Soma as amrita in Indra's assembly is a Puranic motif.

hindi: पार्टी की जाती है।
says: There, gatherings of enjoyment are held; the soma assembly is festive.

hindi: लोगों ने उसको दारू से जोड़ दिया है।
says: People have wrongly tied soma to liquor, he says, losing its sense of consciousness.
classical_check: Soma has been variously interpreted; the liquor reading is one popular view.

gist: Joke: yes brother, soma is going on.
Says see what a word of consciousness it is.
Joke about getting treatment and liquor mixed up.
Joke: liquor was done.
Joke: the medicine stayed behind.
Joke: the liquor worked.
Joke: the medicine did not work.
Says 'yes'.
Joke: someone asks what to do to control the husband.
Joke: is there some medicine, doctor.
Punchline: son, take liquor.

hindi: आपके चंदा मामा के पास नाम दिया गया है सोमवार और 16 सोमवार के व्रत रखवाए जाते हैं कन्या द्वारा कि तुझे एक धांसू सा मक्खन मलाई जैसा पति मिले
says: Because Monday is the Moon's day, girls are made to keep 16 Monday fasts so that they get an excellent, gentle husband.
classical_check: The 16 Somvar vrat for a good husband is a widely observed tradition.

hindi: सोमवार का बहुत लफड़ा है इसका मतलब यानी जो जल तत्व जेल हो जाए पानी जिसके अंदर कुछ भी जेल किया जा सके वो एक दूसरे से जुड़ जाता है
says: The Monday custom reflects the Moon's water element, which gels: water in which things can be dissolved joins one thing to another, so the Moon binds people together.
ambiguity: 'Jel' means gel or bind; wordplay with the English word.

hindi: यदि चंदा मामा राशि मिलाई जाती है शादी के टाइम
says: At marriage the Moon signs of the bride and groom are matched.
ambiguity: Sentence is continued by the next line.
classical_check: Agrees: ashtakoota matching is built on the Moon's sign and nakshatra.

hindi: कहते हैं पंडित जी ने कहा है भाई गुण नहीं मिल रहे नाड़ी दोष होता है, वर्ण दोष होता है, योनि दोष होता है।
says: When the pandit says the gunas do not match, the faults named are nadi dosha, varna dosha and yoni dosha.
classical_check: Nadi, varna and yoni are koota factors in Ashtakoota; agrees.

hindi: चलो यार नाम राशि से मिला देते हैं।
says: If gunas fail on birth sign, families switch to matching by the name sign (nama rashi).
classical_check: Name-based matching is used when birth data is missing; using it to bypass a poor match is a popular practice, not classical.

hindi: तो चंदा मामा की नाम राशि से परिवर्तन करके देखते हैं।
says: They then replace the birth Moon sign by the name-derived Moon sign and recheck the match.

gist: Mimics the pandit: so many gunas matched now.
Mimics: forget it, just perform the marriage.

hindi: तो चंदा मामा का इतना बड़ा महत्व है कि इसी के दम पर विशोत्तरी दशा चलती है कि भैया केतु, मंगल, राहु क्या चल रहा है, किस दशा में बच्चा पैदा हुआ, आगे क्या चलेगा?
says: The Moon is so important that the Vimshottari dasha is run from it, deciding which dasha (Ketu, Mars, Rahu and so on) a child is born in and what follows.
classical_check: Agrees: Vimshottari starts from the Moon's nakshatra.

hindi: और यही निर्धारित करके देता है कि हमारी शादी जहां हो रही है, वहां कितने गुण गण मिले।
says: The Moon alone fixes how many gunas and ganas match between the couple at their wedding.
classical_check: Agrees with Ashtakoota built on the Moon.

hindi: और इसी के दम पर सोमवार के दम पर 16 सोमवार का व्रत रखा गया।
says: On the same strength of Monday the 16-Monday fast came into practice.

gist: Rhetorical: to which deity is the Monday fast kept.

hindi: शिव जी पर रख दिया गया।
says: The Monday fast was dedicated to Lord Shiva.
classical_check: Agrees: Monday fasting is for Shiva.

gist: Rhetorical: how did Shiva come in the middle.

hindi: वो तो एक ओंकार है।
says: Shiva is the single Omkar, the primal sound.

hindi: सब कुछ तो वही है।
says: Everything is Shiva alone, the universal principle.

hindi: मतलब टॉप मोस्ट हरार्की में शिवजी को टॉप पे माना जाता है।
says: In the topmost hierarchy of divinity Shiva is held to be at the very top.
classical_check: Shaiva view; other traditions rank differently.

hindi: निराकार स्वरूप भी है।
says: Shiva also has a formless, nirakar form.

hindi: महा महादेव भी हैं।
says: He is also Mahadev, the great god.

hindi: महा महाकाल भी है।
says: He is also Mahakal, the great lord of time.

hindi: काल से परे समय टाइम डायमेंशन से आगे का देवता जो है वो शिव है।
says: The deity beyond time and beyond the dimension of time is Shiva.

hindi: इनका ना अंत है ना आरंभ है।
says: Shiva has neither end nor beginning.

hindi: विष्णु और ब्रह्मा भी मरते हैं।
says: Even Vishnu and Brahma die at the end of their cycles.
classical_check: Puranic: Brahma and Vishnu are bound within cosmic cycles; Shaiva claim.

hindi: शिव नहीं।
says: Shiva alone does not die.

hindi: अब शिव के पास महामृत्युंजय है।
says: Shiva holds the Mahamrityunjaya, the mantra that conquers death.
classical_check: Agrees: Mahamrityunjaya mantra belongs to Shiva.

hindi: सोच के चलो यार पानी में इतना लफड़ा है कि पानी शिव है।
says: Think it through: so much power lies in water that water itself is Shiva.
classical_check: Silent; his identification of water with Shiva.

gist: Says you will find something interesting.

hindi: पानी में फूंक पड़ते थे।
says: People used to blow mantras into water.
classical_check: Mantra-charged water is a traditional practice.

gist: Mimics a mantra with nonsense syllables.

hindi: हमारे शास्त्रों में ऋषि मुनियों की कथाओं में कहा गया है ना जरा सा कुछ करना नहीं।
says: In the scriptures and the sages' stories little effort is needed; the sage does hardly anything for the result.
classical_check: Agrees with sage stories where a sprinkle of water suffices.

hindi: पानी चाहिए भाई।
says: All the sage needs is water; water is the one ingredient required.

hindi: पानी लाया कमंडल में डाला और भच ये मंत्र याद रखें।
says: The sage fetches water, puts it in the kamandal and chants a mantra over it; he tells the audience to remember this mantra.
ambiguity: 'Bhach' is a garbled mantra sound; the mantra itself is not given.

hindi: बहुत काम का है।
says: This practice is very useful, he stresses.

hindi: बंदे का कुछ भी कर दिया।
says: With that charged water the sage could do anything to the person, whether blessing or curse.

hindi: यानी पानी में चार्जिंग करके आप एनर्जी ट्रांस ट्रांसफर कर सकते हैं।
says: By charging water you can transfer energy to a person, which is how he explains the water-mantra practice.

gist: Rhetorical: such powerful things, does anyone ever try it.

hindi: यह काम करती है।
says: He asserts that it works in practice.
ambiguity: No evidence offered.

gist: Rhetorical: why were Shiva and the gods created.

hindi: कैसे कल्पना की गई यार चंदा मामा जो बिल्कुल पास धरती के ओर दाएं दाएं अटैक मोड पे दो सवा दो दिन के अंदर-अंदर गोल घूमता है।
says: How was Shiva imagined: from the Moon, which stays very close to the Earth, in attack mode, circling and changing sign within about two and a quarter days.
ambiguity: 'Dayen dayen' is unclear; read as hovering close around.
classical_check: Silent; a rationale for the Moon-Shiva link.

hindi: 27 से 28 दिन की साइकिल एक महीने के अंदर लेता है।
says: The Moon completes its zodiac cycle in about 27 to 28 days, within one month.
classical_check: Sidereal month is about 27.3 days; true.

hindi: हमारा ल्यूनर कैलेंडर चलता है वेस्टर्न सिस्टम में सोलर कैलेंडर
says: Our system runs on the lunar calendar, while the western system uses the solar calendar.
classical_check: Hindu calendar is lunisolar, mostly lunar-month based; broadly true.

hindi: और इसी के द्वारा हमारे पास एक पुरुषोत्तम मास आता है चार साल में
says: Through the lunar calendar an extra month, Purushottam maas (adhik maas), is added about every four years to keep it in line with the sun.
ambiguity: Sentence is cut off at the end of the slice.
classical_check: Adhik maas comes about once in 32.5 months, roughly every three years, not four.

gist: Aside that the English add a 29th date to February (leap day) by stretching the month
Says the calendar point is a separate subject

hindi: चंदा मामा जो है इनकी 27 पत्नियां हैं।
says: The Moon has 27 wives, meaning the 27 nakshatras are treated as the Moon's consorts.
ambiguity: Wives = 27 nakshatras is the standard Daksha-daughters story; he does not name it in this sentence.
classical_check: Agrees: 27 nakshatras are the Moon's wives in Puranic tradition.

hindi: चंदा मामा को कहा जाता है इन्हें रोहिणी पत्नी बहुत ज्यादा प्रिय है।
says: Of the Moon's 27 wives, Rohini is the dearest to him, so the Moon is happiest in Rohini nakshatra.
ambiguity: Nakshatra, not sign, is the unit here; the sign link (Taurus) comes in later sentences.
classical_check: Agrees: Moon is exalted in Taurus and Rohini is his favourite wife in tradition.

hindi: रोहिणी नक्षत्र में कृष्ण जी ने बहुत मशहूर किया रोहिणी नक्षत्र कि रोहिणी नक्षत्र में पैदा किए कृष्ण लला उनकी लीलाएं बड़ी न्यारी है।
says: Rohini nakshatra became famous because Krishna was born in it, and Krishna's playful deeds (leela) are unique, which colours how Rohini is read.
ambiguity: Mythological support only; no chart rule is stated yet.
classical_check: Agrees that Krishna's birth star is Rohini (Ashtami, Rohini, Taurus Moon).

hindi: यानी चंदा मामा जब कृष्ण के रोहिणी नक्षत्र में होता है।
says: Sets up the condition: the Moon is placed in Krishna's nakshatra, Rohini; the result follows in the next sentence.
cells_derived_method: Condition only (Moon in Rohini, which lies entirely in Taurus 10 to 23d20m); effect depends on the house the Taurus Moon falls in, see later rows.
ambiguity: Sign is Taurus only because he links Rohini to sign 2 a few sentences later.
classical_check: Rohini is wholly in Taurus; consistent.

hindi: बड़ा लीलाधारी होता है।
says: A Moon in Rohini makes the person a great player of leela, i.e. someone whose life has striking, theatrical, many-coloured episodes.
cells_derived_method: The leela shows up in the department of life of the house Taurus occupies: 2nd house gives dramatic speech and family episodes, 7th gives eventful partnerships, 10th gives a colourful public career.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in Taurus in the 2nd house (lagna Aries) shows leela through voice, food, family and money episodes.
Derived: Moon in Taurus in the 7th house (lagna Scorpio) shows leela through marriage and partners.
Derived: Moon in Taurus in the 10th house (lagna Leo) shows leela through career and public image.

ambiguity: 'Leeladhari' is poetic; no measurable meaning is given.
classical_check: Silent; Rohini is classically described as charming, fond of beauty and display.

gist: Says he plays wonderful leela and the world itself is only leela, the rest is beating
Joke that anyone who gets attached to the Moon gets a beating

hindi: अब रोहिणी नक्षत्र जो है यह राशि नंबर दो का होता है।
says: Rohini nakshatra belongs to sign number 2, which is Taurus.
ambiguity: Sign numbering Aries=1 applies, so 2 = Taurus; not a house number.

hindi: वृष राशि का दो नंबर राशि इसका स्वामी राशिप पति शुक्र ग्रह है।
says: Taurus is sign number 2 and its lord (sign owner) is Venus.

hindi: शुक्र ग्रह शुक्र स्त्री ग्रह है।
says: Venus is a feminine planet.
classical_check: Agrees: Venus is classed female (stri graha).

hindi: अब चंदा मामा चांद एक ऐसी माता समझे जो बड़ी हो गई है।
says: Treat the Moon as a mature, senior mother figure, not a girl; this sets up the Moon-visits-Venus's-house analogy.
classical_check: Agrees: Moon is karaka of mother.

hindi: चंद्रकांता देवी माता है और सूर्यकांत पिता है।
says: In his analogy the Moon is Mother Chandrakanta and the Sun is Father Suryakant, the parental couple.
ambiguity: Names are coined for the analogy; sentence runs across the 19:06 and 20:03 caption chunks.
classical_check: Agrees: Sun is karaka of father, Moon of mother.

hindi: सूर्य से चंद्रकांता उसको रोशनी मिलती है।
says: The Moon gets its light from the Sun.
classical_check: Agrees: Moon is a reflecting luminary; phase strength depends on Sun distance.

hindi: वो गणी मानी जाती है और राजमाता है।
says: The Moon is regarded as the senior lady and the queen mother (rajmata), a position of respect.
ambiguity: First word garbled in captions (likely a word for senior or respected lady).
classical_check: Silent on 'rajmata' wording; Moon as queen is classical (Sun king, Moon queen).

hindi: उनके यहां पर शुक्र जो है वह यूं मान के चलो मस्त मलंग एक नव यवना है।
says: In the analogy Venus living in her own house is like a carefree, fun-loving young woman.

hindi: अब जब वह नव यवना अपनी मौजमस्ती में रहती है और पार्टी करती रहती है अपने घर में तो जैसे ही वहां माता रानी माता जाती है तो वह क्या करती है वो भाई तरीके से तमीज से सेट हो जाती है
says: Analogy: when the senior mother arrives at the party-loving girl's house, the girl immediately behaves, tidies up and hides her makeup and fun.
ambiguity: Story to explain Venus's behaviour when the Moon visits; no direct chart rule yet.

hindi: नहीं छुपा दो सब कुछ यार कोई मेकअप नहीं होगा कोई कुछ नहीं होगा और मेरा सिंहासन मैं माता को देती हूं
says: The girl says to hide everything, no makeup, and gives her own throne to the mother; i.e. Venus yields her seat to the Moon.
ambiguity: Speech inside the story, not a technical rule.

hindi: यानी चंद्रमा जैसे ही शुक्र के घर आता है उसका स्वागत करता है हाथ जोड़ता है हां प्लीज आइए आइए आइए आपका स्वागत है क्योंकि रानी माता आई हैं।
says: So the moment the Moon enters a sign owned by Venus, Venus welcomes it with folded hands because the queen mother has arrived: Venus's sign treats the Moon with great respect.
cells_derived_method: The welcome is a sign-quality statement. Its visible result depends on the house: Moon welcomed in a house of comfort or home (4th), partnership (7th) or income (11th) gives the matching topics support.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in Taurus in the 4th house (lagna Aquarius) welcomed in the house of home and mother, so domestic peace is helped.
Derived: Moon in Taurus in the 11th house (lagna Cancer) welcomed in the house of gains, so steady income and friends are helped.

ambiguity: Venus owns Taurus and Libra; he only says sign 2 in the next sentence, so Libra Moon is not covered.
classical_check: Agrees in effect: Moon is exalted in Taurus; Moon in a friendly sign (Venus is neutral to Moon in classical tables) is comfortable.

hindi: अब रानी माता जब आती हैं तो दो नंबर राशि शुक्र का घर है कुंडली में।
says: The sign where Venus gives this welcome is sign number 2, Taurus, Venus's house in the chart.
ambiguity: 'Number 2' is the sign, not the 2nd house.
classical_check: Agrees; Libra is Venus's other sign but he restricts to sign 2 here.

hindi: यहां चंदा मामा के आते ही सर्वश्रेष्ठ स्वागत मतलब राजमाता अपने घर में भी पति के रहते शायद दबी रहती है।
says: Moon in Taurus gets the best welcome of all, better than in its own home, where the queen mother may remain somewhat suppressed because her husband (the Sun) is present.
cells_derived_method: Compares Moon in Taurus (exalted, welcomed) with Moon in Cancer (own sign, overshadowed by Sun). The result for each house follows house topics: Taurus Moon lifts the house topic strongly, Cancer Moon only moderately.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in Taurus in the 5th house (lagna Capricorn) strongly supports children and intellect.
Derived: Moon in Cancer in the 10th house (lagna Libra) is in its own sign but, on his logic, less showy than a Taurus Moon in career.

ambiguity: He says 'shayad' (maybe); the Cancer comparison is implied, not stated with the sign name.
classical_check: Differs: classics rate own sign good and exaltation better, but do not describe the Sun as suppressing the Moon in Cancer.

hindi: शायद वो भी अच्छा सिंहासन नहीं ले पाती क्योंकि सूर्य ने वहां पर कह रखा है भाई साइड रहो।
says: The queen mother may not get a good seat even at home because the Sun has told her to keep to the side; the Sun dominates the Moon's own place.
ambiguity: Unclear whether the word for there means the Moon own sign Cancer or any house the Sun shares; caption is loose.
classical_check: Silent; classics instead speak of combustion when Moon is near the Sun.

hindi: सिर्फ गुरु आएंगे बृहस्पति तभी हम ध्यान देंगे।
says: The Sun says it will pay attention only if Jupiter comes, so the Moon gets proper support at home only with Jupiter's involvement.
ambiguity: Joining or aspecting is not specified.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Jupiter's association helps the Moon (Gajakesari), but not stated this way in texts.

hindi: अब ये जब चंद्रमा शुक्र के घर जाता है तो बड़ा स्वागत होता है इसका।
says: Restates that when the Moon goes to Venus's house it gets a big welcome.
cells_derived_method: Same as the earlier welcome rule: good support to the topic of whichever house the Taurus Moon sits in.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in Taurus in the 1st house (lagna Taurus) welcomes the self, body and mind: calm, attractive nature.
Derived: Moon in Taurus in the 9th house (lagna Virgo) welcomed in the house of fortune and dharma.

ambiguity: Sentence continues into the 21:03 chunk.
classical_check: Agrees in effect (Moon exalted in Taurus).

hindi: लाजवाब फल।
says: The result of the Moon in Venus's house is outstanding, excellent fruit.
cells_derived_method: Excellent results show in the department of the house occupied.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in Taurus in the 12th house (lagna Gemini) gives good sleep, comfortable expenses and foreign comfort.

ambiguity: No measure of 'lajawab' is given.

hindi: यानी चंद्रमा रोहिणी नक्षत्र जिसकी राशि नंबर दो है वृष राशि वह लाजवाब सब सर्वोत्तम सुख देता है।
says: A Moon in Rohini, in sign 2 Taurus, gives the best of all comforts and pleasures.
cells_derived_method: Comfort and pleasure arrive through the house topic: 4th gives home and vehicle comfort, 2nd gives food and wealth comfort, 7th gives marital comfort, 11th gives comfort through gains.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in Taurus in the 4th house (lagna Aquarius) gives peak home, mother and vehicle comfort.
Derived: Moon in Taurus in the 2nd house (lagna Aries) gives comfort from food, family wealth and speech.
Derived: Moon in Taurus in the 7th house (lagna Scorpio) gives comfort through spouse and partnerships.

ambiguity: 'Sab sarvottam sukh' is a general promise, not conditional on aspects.
classical_check: Agrees in direction: Moon exalted in Taurus gives comforts; Rohini is a fertile, pleasant star.

hindi: अब ऐसा एक ग्रह की कल्पना की जाए जिसके अंदर देवता है वो तो देवता पुरुष हो गया लेकिन शुक्र की राशि में है तो स्त्री तत्व उसमें बराबर तौर पे है और राशि का नाम है वृष।
says: Imagine a deity-planet: the Moon is the male deity, but because it sits in Venus's sign the feminine element is equally present in it, and the sign is named Vrisha (bull).
cells_derived_method: Moon in a Venus sign blends masculine and feminine qualities; the blend colours the topic of the house occupied.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in Taurus in the 5th house (lagna Capricorn) gives children and creativity a balanced gentle and firm quality.
Derived: Moon in Taurus in the 10th house (lagna Leo) blends authority and care in career.

ambiguity: He calls the Moon a male deity here; elsewhere the Moon is feminine, so this is symbolic.
classical_check: Silent; Moon is classically a feminine planet, so his 'male deity' remark differs.

gist: Rhetorical question: who is Vrisha

hindi: बैल।

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in Aries in the 3rd house (lagna Aquarius) gives bold, direct courage.
Derived: Moon in Cancer in the 3rd house (lagna Taurus) gives a gentle, protective courage.
Derived: Moon in Scorpio in the 3rd house (lagna Virgo) debilitated, courage that is intense but unsteady.

classical_check: Partly agrees: Moon in the 3rd gives courage and sibling bond, though it is not a strong placement classically.

hindi: अब आप लगाएं मन है ये मेरा मन कहां कहां है?
says: The Moon is the mind; to read a chart, ask where your mind is, because the house the Moon sits in answers that.
cells_derived_method: The Moon's house is where the mind is engaged: 1st self, 2nd family and money, 3rd effort, 4th home and mother, 5th children and study, 6th enemies.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in Libra in the 7th house (lagna Aries) the mind is engaged with spouse and partners.
Derived: Moon in Cancer in the 10th house (lagna Libra) the mind is engaged with career and public standing.

classical_check: Agrees: the Moon's house shows where the mind rests.

hindi: मेरा मन मुझे में है।
says: Moon in the 1st house: the mind is on oneself.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in Taurus in the 1st house (lagna Taurus) a self-absorbed but contented mind.

ambiguity: House is inferred from 'in me'.
classical_check: Agrees: Moon in the 1st centres the mind on the self.

gist: Asks where my mind is

hindi: मेरा मन परिवार में है।
says: Moon in the 2nd house: the mind is with the family.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in Cancer in the 2nd house (lagna Gemini) a mind tied to family and food.

ambiguity: House inferred from 'family'.

hindi: धन में है।
says: Also in the 2nd house, the mind is on money.

hindi: कुटुंब में है।
says: And the mind is on the extended family (kutumb), the third 2nd-house topic.

gist: Asks again where my mind is

hindi: यह पराक्रम का घर है।
says: The 3rd house is the house of valour and effort, so a Moon here puts the mind on effort.

hindi: कम्युनिकेशन का घर है।
says: The 3rd house is also the house of communication.

hindi: खूब बात नहीं होते ऐसे लोग।
says: People with the Moon in the 3rd are not big talkers or quarrelsome; the caption is garbled, so this reading is uncertain.
ambiguity: Garbled; the original may be a word for chatterers or fighters; the sentence runs across 51:01 and 52:04.

hindi: चंद्रमा सौम्य ग्रह है।
says: The Moon is a gentle (saumya) planet.
classical_check: Agrees: the Moon is a natural benefic when waxing.

gist: Asks what kind of valour such people will show

hindi: सौम्यता से करेंगे।
says: They will show valour with gentleness, not with aggression.

hindi: मजे-मजे करेंगे।
says: They will do their valorous work enjoying it, in a relaxed way.

hindi: लेकिन जीतेंगे हमेशा।
says: But they will always win in their efforts.
ambiguity: An absolute claim with no condition.

hindi: लाजवाब हिसाब रहता है।
says: The accounts of effort and result stay wonderful; the results are always favourable.

gist: Asks whose sign number three is

hindi: बुध की।
says: Sign number 3, Gemini, belongs to Mercury.

gist: Asks what Mercury is

hindi: रेत।
says: In his water scheme Mercury is sand; the Moon in Mercury's sign is water in sandy soil.

gist: Repeats that it is sand

hindi: बिल्कुल व्यर्थ।
says: Sand is completely useless in his image: water poured on sand is of no worth, so Mercury's sign makes the Moon's output hard to use.
ambiguity: Judgement on sand, applied loosely to Mercury.
classical_check: Differs: classics treat Mercury as a benefic and neutral to the Moon.

gist: Says the useless rubbish again
Asks what happens in such a situation

hindi: पराक्रम को लेकर के टूट भी जाता है व्यक्ति।
says: Where the Moon is in Gemini (Mercury's sandy sign), the person may break down over matters of effort and valour.
cells_derived_method: Breakdown shows in the house topic of effort: strongest if Moon in Gemini is in the 3rd or 10th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in Gemini in the 3rd house (lagna Aries) is Moon in its own house of effort within Mercury's sign: efforts break and restart.
Derived: Moon in Gemini in the 10th house (lagna Virgo) career efforts break and restart.

ambiguity: Reading: 'in such a situation' means the Moon in Gemini after the sand image.

hindi: लेकिन जरा सा भी पराक्रम करता है उसको खूब बढ़िया जम के सुख मिलता है।
says: But the smallest effort he makes brings him good, solid happiness; the little work pays off well.
ambiguity: Contrasts with the breakdown line before it; both hold, per him.

hindi: 1% भी दिक्कत नहीं आती।
says: Not even one percent of difficulty comes in the pay-off of that small effort.
ambiguity: Absolute claim, not measured.

hindi: तो ये रेतीली मिट्टी का पानी है ये यहां पर।
says: So the Moon in Gemini is water of sandy soil.

hindi: अगर ऐसी स्थिति में पराक्रम नहीं हो पा रहा आपसे बिल्कुल ढीलू ढालू हो तो कहीं रेत पड़ी हो वहां का पानी लेकर आओ।
says: If you cannot make effort and are completely slack in this situation, bring water from a place where there is sand.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in Gemini in the 3rd house (lagna Aries) with low drive takes sand-place water as the remedy.
Derived: Moon in Gemini in the 10th house (lagna Virgo) with a slack career drive takes sand-place water as the remedy.

hindi: वो लाकर घर में स्थापित करो।
says: Bring that sand-place water and install it at home.

gist: Asks how all this will work out
Says now the fourth

hindi: ये चंद्रमा का अपना घर है।
says: The fourth box is the Moon's own house.
ambiguity: In the natural zodiac the 4th is Cancer, owned by the Moon.
classical_check: Agrees: Moon is karaka of the 4th and owner of Cancer.

hindi: अब चंद्रमा यहां एक नंबर का है, दो का है, तीन है, चार है, आठ है, 10 है, कुछ भी है।
says: The Moon in the 4th house may be in any sign: 1, 2, 3, 4, 8, 10 or whichever; the house is fixed, the sign varies.
cells_derived_method: Moon in the 4th in sign S gives lagna S minus 3.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in Aries (sign 1) in the 4th house means lagna Capricorn.
Derived: Moon in Taurus (sign 2) in the 4th house means lagna Aquarius.
Derived: Moon in Capricorn (sign 10) in the 4th house means lagna Libra.

hindi: लेकिन ये चंद्रमा अपने घर में है।
says: Whatever the sign, the Moon in the 4th is in its own house (bhava).
classical_check: Agrees that the Moon is strong in the 4th (digbala).

hindi: चार नंबर जो भाव है, अपने घर नहीं अपने भाव में।
says: He clarifies: the Moon is in its own bhava (house 4), not necessarily in its own sign Cancer.
classical_check: Agrees: bhava strength (digbala in the 4th) is separate from sign strength.

hindi: चार नंबर के भाव में ये नीच का भी है।
says: Even if the Moon in the 4th house is debilitated (Scorpio), it still sits in its own bhava.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in Scorpio, its debilitation sign, in the 4th house (lagna Leo) sits in its own bhava despite being debilitated.

ambiguity: Debilitation sign taken as Scorpio, which is correct for the Moon.
classical_check: Agrees in part: a debilitated planet in a kendra from lagna gets neecha-bhanga.

hindi: तो भी ये नीच तुल्य होकर भी नीचता का पूरा फल नहीं देगा।
says: The debilitated Moon in the 4th will not give the full bad result of debilitation.
cells_derived_method: Debilitation is softened by the strong house; the soft result shows in home, mother and property.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in Scorpio in the 4th house (lagna Leo) gives some home or mother worry but not the full ruin of a debilitated Moon.

classical_check: Agrees in effect: a kendra debilitation gets neecha-bhanga relief.

hindi: क्योंकि इसका स्थान बहुत अच्छा है।
says: The reason is that the 4th house is a very good place for the Moon.
classical_check: Agrees: the Moon has digbala in the 4th.

hindi: जैसे सूर्य का पांचवा यह स्थान बहुत अच्छा है।
says: Similarly, the 5th house is a very good place for the Sun.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun in Aries (exalted) in the 5th house (lagna Sagittarius) a very strong placement for intellect and children.
Derived: Sun in Libra (debilitated) in the 5th house (lagna Gemini) is softened by the house, by his logic.

classical_check: Differs: classics treat the Sun in the 5th as mixed for children, though good for intellect.

hindi: राहु का छठा स्थान बहुत अच्छा है।
says: The 6th house is a very good place for Rahu.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Rahu in Virgo in the 6th house (lagna Aries) wins over enemies and removes obstacles.
Derived: Rahu in Scorpio in the 6th house (lagna Gemini) wins in disputes and competition.

classical_check: Agrees: Rahu in the 6th is considered good.

hindi: यहां अगर बैठे हैं किसी भी राशि के खराब।
says: If these planets sit in their good houses, even in any bad sign, the house position protects them.
ambiguity: The sentence is loose; the meaning is that house strength outweighs bad sign.
classical_check: Partly agrees: house placement can soften a bad sign, but classics also stress sign strength.

gist: Says now he is speaking of sign number four

hindi: तो यह प्योर दूध है।
says: The Moon in sign 4 (Cancer, its own sign) is pure milk.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in Cancer in the 4th house (lagna Aries) is pure, the strongest case for home, mother and comfort.
Derived: Moon in Cancer in the 10th house (lagna Libra) pure and caring in career and public work.

classical_check: Agrees: Moon in own sign is strong.

hindi: ऐसे व्यक्ति की इतनी ज्यादा आमदनी होती है कि अगर वह आमदनी बढ़ाना चाहता है तो उसको खर्चे बढ़ाने चाहिए
says: Such a person has so much income that, to raise it further, he should raise his spending. This is his financial-style claim, recorded as his statement only and not as advice.
ambiguity: Whether 'such a person' means the 4th house Moon or the Cancer Moon is not clear; he turns to the 4th house in the following lines.

hindi: क्योंकि चारप गुना आमदनी बढ़ती है खर्चे से तो अगर वो व्यक्ति ₹100 खर्चता है तो उसको 400 खर्चने चाहिए ₹1600 आएंगे 2000 आएंगे
says: Because income rises about four times the spending, if he spends 100 rupees he should spend 400, and 1600 to 2000 will come. A money claim recorded as his statement only; not investment advice.
ambiguity: Numbers are loose, and 4 times for income against expense is not exact arithmetic.

hindi: तो चालाकी यहां ये है कि चौथे चंद्रमा वाला व्यक्ति खर्चा ज्यादा करे
says: So the trick is that a person with the Moon in the 4th should spend more, not less.
ambiguity: Financial remark recorded as his claim; no advice.

gist: Garbled lines about what to do if there is a 4th-house Moon, and who knows or goes about looking

hindi: ये मां का स्थान है ये पिता का स्थान है या माता का है
says: The 4th house is the place of the mother; he wonders aloud between father and mother and settles on mother.
ambiguity: Some texts give the 4th to the father; he says mother.
classical_check: Agrees: 4th is mother in most traditions; some systems say father.

hindi: तो माता के ऊपर खर्चा करो माह पर खर्चा करोगे उतना धन चार गुना पांच गुना बढ़ के आएगा।
says: So spend money on your mother; whatever you spend on her returns four or five times. A tradition claim about money, not advice.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in Cancer in the 4th house (lagna Aries) the strongest case for the mother-spending remedy.
Derived: Moon in Capricorn in the 4th house (lagna Libra) the same remedy, with more effort needed.

ambiguity: Word 'maah' is a caption error for mother; the multiple 4 to 5 is his figure.

gist: Says it is a strange situation and we turn out to be very stingy

hindi: यह माता है, चंद्रमा मां है, शुक्र पत्नी है, बृहस्पति पति है, सूर्य पिता है।
says: The Moon is the mother, Venus is the wife, Jupiter is the husband and the Sun is the father.
classical_check: Agrees: Venus for husband in a man's chart and Jupiter for husband in a woman's; he gives wife and husband simply.

gist: Says this is how it goes

hindi: यहीं पर आपके मकान है, जमीन है, जायदाद है, वैभव है, पुश्तैनी जायदाद।
says: The 4th house also shows your house, land, property, grandeur and ancestral property.

hindi: अगर इन सब चीजों में आपके लफड़ा चला हुआ है, तो घर में दूध स्थापित करो।
says: If there is trouble in these 4th-house matters, install milk in the house: keep milk as the Moon remedy.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in Cancer in the 4th house (lagna Aries) with property trouble would take milk as the remedy by his logic.
Derived: Moon in Scorpio in the 4th house (lagna Leo) with property trouble would take milk as the remedy by his logic.

ambiguity: It is not clear whether 'establish milk' means keeping a vessel of milk or using milk in worship; the sentence runs across 53:00 and 54:06.

hindi: नहीं तो किसी चश्मे का पानी लेकर आओ और मीठे चश्मे का पानी लाकर के घर में रख दो।
says: Otherwise bring water from a natural spring, especially a sweet one, and keep it at home.
ambiguity: An alternative to the milk remedy, for the same 4th-house trouble.

hindi: चंद्रमा की उत्तमता को स्थापित करना है हमें।
says: The aim of all these remedies is to establish the excellence of the Moon.

hindi: यह सूर्य का घर है पांच नंबर।
says: Box number 5 (Leo, the 5th house in the natural chart) is the Sun's house.
ambiguity: House and sign are the same here because he is walking the natural zodiac.

hindi: चंद्रमा अगर पांच नंबर का होता है तो सत्यानाश है।
says: If the Moon is in number 5 (the Sun's house) it is ruinous.
cells_derived_method: Moon in Leo is read by the house it falls in; ruin shows in that house's topic.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in Leo in the 5th house (lagna Aries) children and studies are damaged by his logic.
Derived: Moon in Leo in the 10th house (lagna Scorpio) career and reputation are damaged by his logic.
Derived: Moon in Leo in the 2nd house (lagna Cancer) wealth and family are damaged by his logic.

ambiguity: 'Number 5' may mean the 5th house or the sign Leo; he later says 'fifth house' so both are given.
classical_check: Differs: classics treat Moon in Leo as neutral to mildly positive, since the Sun is the Moon's friend.

hindi: कलह रहती है।
says: Quarrel and conflict persist when the Moon is in the Sun's house.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in Leo in the 7th house (lagna Aquarius) conflict in marriage and partnerships.
Derived: Moon in Leo in the 4th house (lagna Taurus) conflict at home.

hindi: यानी सूरज के घर में चला गया।
says: The Moon has gone into the Sun's house, which he reads as the cause of the problem.

gist: Asks what the Sun is

hindi: जलती आग।
says: The Sun is burning fire.
classical_check: Agrees: Sun is a fire planet.

hindi: सूरज के घर में पानी डाल दिया।
says: Putting water (the Moon) into the Sun's house is like pouring water on a burning fire.

gist: Asks what will happen
Answers: nothing

hindi: गायब उसका अस्तित्व भी समाप्त हो गया।
says: The water disappears; even its existence ends. The Moon's identity is wiped out in the Sun's fire.

hindi: इंसान का जहां चंद्रमा पड़ गया उसका अस्तित्व खत्म।
says: For the person, wherever the Moon has fallen here, his own existence is finished; his sense of self is lost in that area.
ambiguity: 'Jahan' means where in the chart; taken here as the 5th house box he is on.

hindi: यहां चंद्रमा बैठा है पांचवे घर का।
says: Here the Moon is sitting in the fifth house.
ambiguity: Setup for what the 5th house shows.

gist: Asks what is in the 5th

hindi: पढ़ाई।
says: The 5th house shows education.

hindi: बाल बच्चे
says: The 5th house also shows children.
ambiguity: Fragment start of a longer run-on sentence.

hindi: इंसान का खुद का अस्तित्व खत्म
says: With the Moon in the 5th, the person's own existence (sense of self) is finished in these matters.
ambiguity: Repeats the earlier loss-of-existence idea in the 5th house context.

hindi: पढ़ाई करी कोई काम नहीं आया
says: He studied but it was of no use to him; education does not pay off for the person with the Moon in the 5th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in Scorpio in the 5th house (lagna Cancer) education leads to little practical gain.
Derived: Moon in Aquarius in the 5th house (lagna Libra) education is theoretical and rarely applied.

classical_check: Silent; classics give Moon in the 5th a good intellect.

hindi: बच्चे तो सफल हो गए मैं सफल नहीं हुआ मेरी सफलता के नाम पे कुछ नहीं
says: The children become successful but I do not; there is nothing to show as my own success, so the 5th-house Moon gives the children's success, not the parent's.

hindi: अब मान लो यहां चंद्रमा पांच है
says: Now suppose the Moon is in sign 5 (Leo) here, in the box of property (4th house).
cells_derived_method: Moon in Leo in the 4th house gives lagna Scorpio.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in Leo in the 4th house (lagna Taurus) is the case he sets up for property.

ambiguity: 'Yahan' is unclear: the 4th house with sign 5 is inferred from the next lines about property.

gist: Asks what would happen if the same Moon were here as number five

hindi: प्रॉपर्टी तो बन गई उसका फायदा कोई नहीं है
says: Property does get built, but there is no benefit from it.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in Leo in the 4th house (lagna Taurus) gives property, but without comfort or use from it.

ambiguity: Box assumed from 'property'.

hindi: यहां तो आ गई शादी तो हो गई पत्नी राम भरोसे पति राम भरोसे
says: If the Moon in sign 5 comes to the marriage box (7th), marriage happens but the wife or husband is left to fate; the marriage is hollow.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in Leo in the 7th house (lagna Aquarius) marriage takes place, but the couple's bond is left to chance.

ambiguity: The box is not named; the 7th is inferred from marriage.

hindi: यानी कि ये खराब है लेकिन जहां बैठा है वहां को उत्तम कर देगा एकदम उत्तम लाजवाब
says: So it is bad, yet wherever it sits it will make that place excellent, absolutely excellent. He contradicts his earlier ruin claim.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in Leo in the 4th house (lagna Taurus) is poor for the person but gives property.
Derived: Moon in Leo in the 10th house (lagna Scorpio) is poor for the self but lifts career.

ambiguity: Self-contradiction: the Moon in the Sun's house is ruinous for the person yet makes the house itself excellent.

hindi: ये नहर का पानी होता है जो बहती हुई नहर नहीं है कैनाल जल रही है वो पानी ला के रखो
says: The Moon in Leo is canal water, not a flowing stream; bring that canal water and keep it as the remedy.
ambiguity: The caption says 'jal rahi' (burning), maybe meaning flowing water; reading is uncertain.

gist: Asks whose use it is for

hindi: किसी के काम नहीं आता।
says: Canal water serves no one's purpose, so this Moon's help does not reach others.

hindi: नहर के पानी का कोई लेनदेन नहीं है।
says: Canal water has no give and take with anyone; the Moon in Leo is cut off from exchange.

gist: Says it is of no use to anyone

hindi: यह आपका राहु का घर है।
says: The 6th box is Rahu's house in his scheme (Virgo given to Rahu).
ambiguity: He gives Virgo to Rahu as well as Mercury; here he points at the 6th box.
classical_check: Differs: classically Virgo belongs only to Mercury; Rahu rules it in his scheme.

hindi: छह नंबर का चंद्रमा।
says: Now the Moon in number 6 (the 6th box).
ambiguity: Setup for the 6th house results that follow; he later says house and not sign.

hindi: यह हैंडपंप का पानी है।
says: The Moon in the 6th is handpump water: ordinary, hard-worked, groundwater.

hindi: छठे घर का चंद्रमा मतलब शत्रु।
says: The Moon in the 6th house means enemies; the mind is full of opponents.
cells_derived_method: Enemy theme is strongest when the Moon is weak in the 6th; in strong signs it gives power over enemies.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in Scorpio (debilitated) in the 6th house (lagna Gemini) a mind full of enemies and suspicion.
Derived: Moon in Taurus (exalted) in the 6th house (lagna Sagittarius) the enemies are present but handled calmly.

classical_check: Agrees: Moon in the 6th is weak and gives enemies, worry and illness.

hindi: आपको लगता है सारी दुनिया शत्रु है आपकी।
says: You feel the whole world is your enemy; the 6th-house Moon gives suspicion.
classical_check: Agrees in effect: Moon in the 6th gives suspicion and mental conflict.

gist: Punjabi-like garbled fragment about someone doing something

hindi: अगर आपके मन में ये आग लगी पड़ी है।
says: If this fire of hostility is burning in your mind, that is the inner state of a 6th-house Moon.
ambiguity: Remedy or result is not completed in the sentence.

hindi: सर छह नंबर का चंद्रमा मतलब छठी राशि छठे भाव।
says: He first conflates 'number 6' with the 6th sign and the 6th house and then corrects himself in the next sentence.
ambiguity: Mixes sign 6 (Virgo) and house 6; settled in the next sentence as house 6.

hindi: छठे भाव की बात हो रही है इस समय राशि की बात नहीं हो रही है।
says: The talk is about the 6th house now and not about the sign.
classical_check: Agrees on separating house from sign.

hindi: छठे भाव में है यह किसी भी राशि का बैठा हो चंद्रमा का मेजर इफेक्ट ये होगा कि रोपिटर

hindi: सब ग्रहों का खेल है।
says: It is all the play of the planets; events are planetary, not moral choices.

hindi: कोई किसी के लिए महान काम नहीं कर रहा।
says: Nobody is doing a great deed for anyone else; apparent virtue is just chart behaviour.

hindi: कोई किसी के लिए बलिदान नहीं कर रहा।
says: Nobody makes a real sacrifice for another; all is a result of one's own planetary position.

hindi: हम पीड़ित हैं।
says: We are the afflicted ones; the parents are not heroes but victims of the child's 8th-house Moon.
ambiguity: Who 'we' refers to is unclear.

hindi: ऐसा बच्चा हो जाता है।
says: Such a child is born, one carrying this Moon pattern.

hindi: अपनी मां के लिए भारी होता है।
says: The child weighs heavily on his own mother, a burden in hardship terms.
classical_check: Silent; classical says it troubles mother.

hindi: मां को मार देता है जान से।
says: He says the child kills the mother outright, a strong form of the same claim (tradition claim only, no timing).
ambiguity: Literal death of the mother stated; do not turn into a forecast.

hindi: राशि कोई भी हो।
says: Whatever the sign, the 8th-house Moon still produces the effect, only its intensity changes.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in Aries in the 8th (lagna Virgo) - effect present, with sharp Mars-style severity.
Derived: Moon in own sign Cancer in the 8th (lagna Sagittarius) - effect present but gentle.

hindi: कोई भी राशि हो अगर बुरी राशि है तो भयंकर मारता है।
says: If the Moon's sign is a bad sign, the damage to the mother is severe.
cells_derived_method: Bad sign means debilitated or enemy sign for the Moon.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon debilitated in Scorpio in the 8th (lagna Aries) - fierce version.
Derived: Moon in Capricorn (Saturn's sign, enemy-like) in the 8th (lagna Gemini) - severe cold-draining effect.

ambiguity: His list of bad signs is not given.

hindi: अच्छी राशि हो गई तो बहुत कम मारता है।
says: With a good sign it harms the mother only slightly.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon exalted in Taurus in the 8th (lagna Libra) - minimal harm.

hindi: अगर ये अमृत राशि अमृत जैसी स्थिति है तो मां को मरने भी नहीं देता।
says: If the sign is of the nectar kind, the Moon protects the mother and does not even let her die.
cells_derived_method: Best sign version is protective of mother.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in own sign Cancer in the 8th (lagna Sagittarius) - nectar-like, mother kept alive.

hindi: ऐसे मारता है।
says: This is how the bad-sign 8th Moon kills; pointer to the next description, rotting away.

hindi: सड़ के मार देता है।
says: The death comes through slow rotting, a prolonged decay rather than sudden end.
ambiguity: Reads as a prolonged-illness pattern, not a medical claim.

hindi: सड़-सड़ के मरते हैं ना लोग।
says: Appeals to common experience: people do die by slow decay, so this is a real pattern.

hindi: यह दोष होता है।
says: This is a defect (dosha) of the 8th-house Moon.
ambiguity: Named dosha is not given.
classical_check: Not a standard classical dosha name.

hindi: दूसरे ग्रह ऐसे जो सूर्य के दोष से होते हैं वो पिता को मारते हैं।
says: Other cases: where the defect is from the Sun, the harm falls on the father instead of the mother.
cells_derived_method: Sun is father; the same afflicted-in-8th pattern would apply to the Sun for the father. House not specified here.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun exalted in Aries in the 8th (lagna Virgo) - nectar-like version by his logic.
Derived: Sun debilitated in Libra in the 8th (lagna Pisces) - harsh version for the father.

ambiguity: Which house for the Sun is not stated.

hindi: कई बेटे ऐसे हैं जो बाप को पीटते हैं।
says: Many sons beat their fathers; he gives this as the Sun-defect result.

hindi: ये भी स्थिति बनती है।
says: This situation of conflict with the father also arises.

hindi: पर ये अमृत भी बन जाता है।
says: But the same placement can turn to nectar, a benefit in a good sign.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in Pisces in the 8th (lagna Leo) - friendly sign, nectar side.

hindi: ऐसी स्थिति में आप जो सैटर्न ट्रांजिट आ गया है।
says: In the nectar-state case, a Saturn transit has arrived; he is addressing a worry about it.
ambiguity: Which Moon position Saturn is transiting is not given; he probably means the 8th.
classical_check: Saturn transit over Moon (sade sati type) is feared classically; he downplays it.

hindi: आने दो हमें क्या लेना देना?
says: Let it come: with this protected Moon, the Saturn transit is no concern.
ambiguity: Not conditioned on exact chart; claim for the nectar state only.
classical_check: Differs from classical fear of Saturn over Moon.

gist: Challenge: let Saturn just come and show itself.
Repeats the challenge: let it come here and show.
Rhetorical: where has it come?
It has come, mocking answer.
Repeats that it has come.
Then start being scared, sarcastically.
Tell me again in five minutes.
I will also shiver with fear, jokingly.
Both of us will shiver.
Checking agreement: okay?

hindi: यह श्मशान का पानी है।
says: The water type for this case is cremation-ground water.

hindi: ऐसी स्थिति में घर में श्मशान का पानी लेकर रखो।
says: In such a case, bring cremation-ground water and keep it in the house as the remedy.

hindi: यह आठ नंबर राशि का चंद्रमा या आठवें घर का चंद्रमा।
says: The cremation-water remedy is for Moon in sign number 8 (Scorpio) or Moon in the 8th house.
cells_derived_method: Both sign 8 and house 8 trigger the remedy; they overlap in the cell (8, Scorpio).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon debilitated in Scorpio in the 8th (lagna Aries) - both triggers at once, strongest need.
Derived: Moon debilitated in Scorpio in the 3rd (lagna Virgo) - sign trigger only.
Derived: Moon in Gemini in the 8th (lagna Scorpio) - house trigger only.

ambiguity: Sign number 8 Scorpio versus house number 8; he lists both.

hindi: इसमें हम एक नंबर भी साथ लेते हैं।
says: Number 1 (Aries or the 1st house) is also taken along with 8 for this remedy.
cells_derived_method: Adds Moon in Aries or in the 1st house to the cremation-water category.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in own sign Cancer in the 1st (lagna Cancer) - house-number-1 trigger.
Derived: Moon in Aries in the 6th (lagna Scorpio) - sign-number-1 trigger.

ambiguity: Unclear whether 1 means Aries or 1st house, or both; recorded both.
classical_check: Not classical (Aries and Scorpio are both Mars signs).

gist: Repeats that such a person should keep cremation water at home.

hindi: श्मशान के अंदर बोरिंग का पानी जो शमशान से निकला।
says: The water should be borewell water drawn inside the cremation ground, that comes out of that ground.

gist: Setup: people saying they have been hit by the evil eye.
Setup: people saying someone did black magic on them.
Setup: evil eye from a glance, and a child not thriving.

hindi: भाई नमक से नजर उतार ले।
says: The ordinary approach for evil eye is to remove it with salt, which he mentions as the common first try.

hindi: इससे कर ले ठीक नहीं हो रहा।
says: If the salt method has been tried and nothing improves, escalate to the cremation-water remedy.
ambiguity: Reads as a complaint of a person who tried salt in vain.

hindi: तो आपको श्मशान का पानी चाहिए।
says: For persistent evil-eye problems linked to the Moon, you need cremation-ground water.

hindi: तो आपके ऊपर जो नजर लगती है जो आपकी बॉडी पर चंद्रमा की लगती है।
says: The evil eye that strikes the body is the Moon's, since the Moon rules the body's water.
classical_check: Not classical; Moon as body fluids is classical.

gist: Example of a visiting elderly woman or goddess-type visitor looking at the child.
Example of a neighbour uncle visiting, child ill since.
Says this does happen.

hindi: छोटे बच्चे की बॉडी के अंदर वीक होती है औररा उसकी क्योंकि बहुत मासूम है।
says: A small child's aura is weak because he is innocent, so the child is more exposed to the evil eye.

hindi: तो किसी की नेगेटिव औररा से उसके शरीर के चंद्रमा यानी पानी के ऊपर नेगेटिव एनर्जी आ जाती है और नजर लग जाती है।
says: Another person's negative aura puts negative energy on the child's body-Moon, meaning the water in the body, and that is how the evil eye sticks.

hindi: तो नजर हटाने का काम केतु वगैरह करते हैं।
says: Removing the evil eye is the work of Ketu and similar planets.
classical_check: Ketu as protector from unseen forces is a folk reading.

hindi: ये केतु के द्वारा ट्रीटमेंट होती है।
says: The treatment of the evil eye is done through Ketu.

hindi: दवाई नहीं करती।
says: Medicine does not work for evil-eye affliction. Recorded as his claim; not medical advice, see a doctor for illness.
ambiguity: Medical claim by him, not endorsed.

hindi: नजर उतारो ठीक हो गया।
says: Remove the evil eye and the child is cured.
ambiguity: A health outcome claim; flagged as his belief only.

hindi: सूर्य की नजर उतरती है आपकी नमक से
says: The Sun's evil eye (the kind coming from the Sun's domain) is removed with salt.
ambiguity: Garbled; could be 'nazar of the Sun' removed using salt, or a different split.

hindi: तेल पीले तेल से उतारते हैं सरसों के तेल से वो आप बृहस्पति की होती है
says: Evil eye removed using yellow oil, mustard oil, belongs to Jupiter.
ambiguity: Garbled; Jupiter yellow colour link is clear.
classical_check: Folk remedy; yellow-Jupiter link is classical.

hindi: इस प्रकार तो ऐसे में श्मशान का पानी ला करके घर में रखो नजर नहीं लगेगी
says: Therefore bring cremation water and keep it at home, and the evil eye will not take hold.

hindi: कहां रखो कहीं भी रखो
says: As for placement, keep it anywhere in the house.

hindi: नॉर्थ में रख लो ईस्ट में रख लो सबसे अच्छा एरिया है
says: North and east are the best areas for keeping the water.
classical_check: Vastu: north-east water placement is standard.

hindi: वेस्ट भी एक एरिया है लेकिन फिर वो परिस्थिति अनुसार है व्यक्ति के
says: West is also an option but depends on the person's circumstances.

gist: Repeats: this way the evil eye will not strike.

hindi: अगर आपको कर्म स्थान में लग रहा है कि मेरे काम पे नजर लग गई है शमशान का पानी ला करके कर्म स्थान पे रख दो
says: If you feel your workplace or business is under evil eye, keep cremation water at the workplace.
cells_derived_method: Karma sthana is the 10th house or the actual workplace; the remedy follows the workplace location rather than the sign.

hindi: कि हां भाई वहां पड़ा है आपको नजर लगनी है आगे बंद हो जाएगी
says: With the water placed there, any evil eye aimed at you will stop at the water and be blocked.
ambiguity: Wording is loose; meaning is that the water acts as a shield.

hindi: पिछ बिछली के लिए उसमें चार कड़क सूखी लाल मिर्च जला के देखते हैं।
says: To test whether evil eye is present, burn four dry red chillies and watch the reaction.
ambiguity: First phrase is garbled; purpose of test inferred from next sentence.

hindi: अगर धसक उठी तो यानी कि नजर नहीं है।

hindi: अगर नहीं उठी तो नजर लगी हुई है।
says: If there is no cough from the burning chillies, evil eye is present.

hindi: पानी रखना होता है।
says: The cremation water has to be kept at home continuously.

hindi: इसकी कोई ड्यूरेशन होती है दो साल रखो।
says: There is a duration for keeping it: two years.

hindi: तीन साल रखो खराब हो जाए घट जाए तो नया ले आओ।
says: Or keep three years; if the water spoils or reduces, replace it with fresh water.

hindi: हां श्मशान खुद ही चले जाना चाहिए।
says: One should go to the cremation ground oneself and fetch the water personally.
ambiguity: Reply to an audience question about asking someone else.

hindi: सबमर्सिबल लगा होगा।

hindi: कहीं से भी ले लो।
says: Source is flexible: take the water from any cremation ground.

hindi: जमीन के अंदर का पानी चाहिए।

says: If an action feels good to your mind (Moon), do it fully, 100 percent; the Moon's contentment is the guide.

says: This is why children are healthy: a mind that follows what it likes stays healthy.

says: A little child's Moon (mind) stays happy, as its mind is unburdened.

hindi: चाइनीज मोती ले आओ।
says: Even a Chinese (cultured) pearl will do.
classical_check: Classical texts prefer natural pearl; he relaxes this.

hindi: ₹100 का पत्थर आएगा।
says: Such a pearl stone costs only about 100 rupees.
ambiguity: Price figure only.

hindi: अब बसरा का लाना है उसका लाना है।
says: If you want the costlier Basra (natural Gulf) pearl, you can buy that.

hindi: मर्जी है भाई काम करेगा वो भी।
says: It is your choice; even the cheaper one will work.

gist: Audience member says there will be confusion about the 7th-house remedy.
Questioner restates that field-flooding water is kept at home.

hindi: तो वो पानी यह वो पानी है जो खेतों को सींचने के लिए काम आता है।
says: Clears the confusion: the 7th-house water is water that serves to irrigate fields, not any random field flooding.

gist: Audience: tubewells and so on are installed, aren't they?
Audience: small tubewells are installed.
Agreement that fields do have tubewells.

hindi: मतलब हमारी रेमेडी यहां पे ये चलती थी ना कि यहां पर दबाना है ये हां ये दबाने वाला है
says: Recalls the earlier remedy in this house, which involved pressing or burying; here he separates that from the water's form.
ambiguity: 'Dabana' could mean to bury or to press; garbled.

hindi: लेकिन यहां जो पानी का स्वरूप है वो कौन सा है वो खेतों में जोतने वाला जो पानी है उसका स्वरूप है
says: But the form of the water here is that used for farming fields, field-ploughing and irrigation water, not the burying part.

gist: Says he will explain all details later.

hindi: जैसे मान लो यहां चंद्रमा है।
says: Takes the example of Moon sitting in the 7th house to explain the field-water logic.

hindi: अब ये धन दे रहा है घर गृहस्ती दे रहा है तो काम आएगा खेतों में जाने वाला पानी की तरह है
says: Moon in the 7th gives money and a household, and like field-bound water this wealth flows outward to be used elsewhere.
cells_derived_method: 7th = spouse, household, trade; the wealth passes through to others. Sign sets how much stays.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in Capricorn in the 7th (lagna Cancer) - earnings and household duties flow to a heavy spouse or partner side.
Derived: Moon in own sign Cancer in the 7th (lagna Capricorn) - more retention at home, but still shared out.

classical_check: Classical: Moon in 7th gives gain via partner, not 'serves others'; he adds the field-water image.

hindi: औरों के काम आएगा अपने नहीं आएगा।
says: It will be useful to others but not to oneself; the person works for others' benefit.

hindi: इसलिए इसलिए वहां का पानी यहां रखा है।
says: This is why the water from the fields is prescribed here: it matches the Moon's field-water nature.

hindi: ये रखा है तो ये ग्रह के लिए है।
says: Keeping this water is for the planet: it works on the planet, the Moon.

hindi: शांति के लिए
says: The aim of the water is shanti, pacifying or calming the planet.
ambiguity: Fragment; completes the thought of the previous sentence.
classical_check: Shanti remedies are classical in aim.

hindi: लेकिन ऐसा स्वभाव है चंद्रमा का कि भैया औरों के काम आऊंगा अपने तो आऊंगा ही नहीं।
says: Yet the Moon here has the nature of saying: I will be useful to others and never to myself; remedy only pacifies, it does not change this nature.

hindi: तो ये जो भी धन कमा रहा है घर गृहस्ती ला रहा है उसके जीवन के अंदर अपना सुख नहीं मिलेगा।
says: Whatever money or household he brings, he himself will not get personal happiness out of it.
cells_derived_method: Personal happiness from earnings is denied by the Moon in the house of others; little sign dependence stated.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon debilitated in Scorpio in the 7th (lagna Taurus) - earns for family, with the least private joy.

hindi: जिस लड़की का चंद्रमा सातवां होता है।
says: Introduces the case of a woman who has the Moon in the 7th house.

hindi: वो सारी जिंदगी पति को छोड़ती नहीं है और सारी जिंदगी सुख भी नहीं मिलता पति से।
says: A woman with Moon in the 7th never leaves her husband all her life, yet never gets happiness from him.
cells_derived_method: 7th = husband for a woman, Moon = attachment. Sign changes the happiness part, not the attachment.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in own sign Cancer in the 7th (lagna Capricorn) - deepest attachment, some comfort.
Derived: Moon debilitated in Scorpio in the 7th (lagna Taurus) - attachment stays, happiness least.

classical_check: Classical: Moon in 7th for a woman gives an attached but sometimes emotional marriage; he says harsher.

hindi: और आठ आठ किसी भले ही कुटाई होती रहे।
says: Even if she keeps getting beaten, she stays; garbled caption but the sense is persistence despite abuse.
ambiguity: Garbled words 'aath aath kisi'; meaning inferred from the next sentence.

hindi: पति महाराज ऐसे हैं तो फिर भी इतनी के पीछे पड़े रहते हैं।
says: Even if the husband is like that, she still keeps running behind him; the wording is partly garbled.
ambiguity: 'Itni ke peeche' is unclear.

hindi: चंद्रमा मन वही है उसका।
says: The Moon is her mind, and her mind is fixed on the husband.

hindi: अगर बुरी राशि का है तो बुरे तरीके से भी वही है।
says: If the Moon is in a bad sign the attachment is still the same, just in a bad way.
cells_derived_method: Sign worsens the manner but the house keeps the focus on partner.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon debilitated in Scorpio in the 7th (lagna Taurus) - same attachment, bitter and jealous manner.
Derived: Moon exalted in Taurus in the 7th (lagna Scorpio) - same attachment in a stable, pleasing manner.

hindi: मन तो वही है।
says: The mind (Moon) is the same regardless of sign: it stays fixed on the same object.

hindi: मन तो धन में है तो धन में ही है।
says: If the mind sits in money it stays in money; the house placement decides what the Moon clings to.
cells_derived_method: Moon clings to the topic of its house: 2nd/11th money, 7th partner, etc.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in own sign Cancer in the 2nd (lagna Gemini) - mind fixed on money and family stores.
Derived: Moon exalted in Taurus in the 11th (lagna Cancer) - mind fixed on gains.

gist: Rhetorical: where is the mind?
Says this is complex.

hindi: थोड़ा मैं समझ रहा हूं इसको कठिनाई है क्योंकि राशियों का इसका कॉम्बिनेशन उसका कॉम्बिनेशन चलित का बहुत लफड़े वाली चीज है।
says: It is hard because house-sign combinations and the bhava-chalit chart multiply the cases; this is messy work.
classical_check: Consistent with the difficulty of bhava-chalit shifts.

gist: Audience: you said 7th with Sagittarius would come different.

hindi: अलग आएगा।
says: Yes, the result will come out different depending on the sign.
cells_derived_method: Same house, different sign = different reading.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: 7th house falling in Sagittarius (lagna Gemini) - Jupiter flavour on the partner side.
Derived: 7th in Libra (lagna Aries) - Venus flavour on the partner side.

hindi: राशि बदलेंगे ना अभी।
says: We will vary the sign now: he will move to the sign dimension later to show how results change.
ambiguity: Could mean he changes the example sign now.

gist: Says that is why he started the session early today.

hindi: यह नौवा घर है।
says: Now moving on to the 9th house.

gist: Repeats: the ninth house.

hindi: यह बृहस्पति का घर होता है।
says: The 9th house is the house of Jupiter (natural sign Sagittarius).
classical_check: Agrees: 9th is the Sagittarius house, ruled by Jupiter.

hindi: बहुत मरदित होता है यहां चंद्रमा।
says: Moon is very joyful and content here (caption word is probably 'mudit', glad) in the 9th house.
cells_derived_method: 9th = dharma, luck, higher mind; Moon is comfortable. Sign adds details.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in own sign Cancer in the 9th (lagna Scorpio) - very strong fortune and devotion.
Derived: Moon debilitated in Scorpio in the 9th (lagna Pisces) - joy reduced by intensity and doubt.

ambiguity: 'Mardit' is a caption error, possibly 'mudit' (happy) or 'mardit' (crushed); context says good.
classical_check: Classical: Moon in 9th is generally good for fortune and dharma; agrees.

hindi: मरदित गुड।
says: Summing up the Moon in the 9th: good.

hindi: चंद्रमाएं भाग रहा है।
says: The Moon is running, it is the fastest-moving body.
classical_check: Agrees: Moon is the fastest planet.

gist: It is running.
It is running, third time.

hindi: ढाई दिन ढाई दिन मन बदल रहा है।
says: The Moon stays about two and a half days in each sign, so the mind changes with it.
classical_check: Agrees: Moon is about 2.25 days per sign.

hindi: लगातार बदल रहा है।
says: The mind keeps changing without stop.

hindi: ये बड़ा मर्यादा से चलता है।
says: In the 9th house this Moon moves with great decorum and discipline.

hindi: ऐसे लोग सिद्ध बन जाते हैं।
says: Such people become siddhas, accomplished spiritual persons.
cells_derived_method: 9th = guru and dharma; strongest in Jupiter signs or Cancer.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in Pisces in the 9th (lagna Cancer) - Jupiter's water sign, strongest saintly tendency.
Derived: Moon in Capricorn in the 9th (lagna Taurus) - more worldly, duty-bound path.

classical_check: Silent on siddha; Moon in 9th is dharmic.

hindi: साधु बनते हैं।
says: They become sadhus (renunciates or holy persons).
ambiguity: Tendency, not certainty.

hindi: समुद्र के पानी की तरह है।
says: The water type for the 9th-house Moon is sea water; the nature is vast like the ocean.
ambiguity: Either the remedy water or the character image.

hindi: ये यानी कि सबको सप्लाई दूंगा।
says: The attitude is: I will supply to everyone, a giver to all.

hindi: सबको पालने वाला।
says: He is a nourisher of all, one who raises and supports everyone.

hindi: सबका ध्यान रखने वाला।
says: He takes care of everyone's wellbeing.

hindi: नाइंथ हाउस के चंद्रमा वाला व्यक्ति सबका ख्याल रखता है।
says: Summary: a person with Moon in the 9th house looks after everybody.
cells_derived_method: Sign varies how wide the caring is: water signs broad, earth signs practical.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon exalted in Taurus in the 9th (lagna Virgo) - practical, material care.
Derived: Moon in own sign Cancer in the 9th (lagna Scorpio) - emotional, motherly care.

hindi: उसके लिए भेदभाव जैसी चीज ही नहीं होती।
says: For such a person there is no discrimination; he treats all alike.

hindi: 10थ हाउस का चंद्रमा यह चौथे घर को एस्पेक्ट कर रहा है।
says: Moon in the 10th house aspects the 4th house, the usual seventh aspect.
cells_derived_method: 10th to 4th is the 7th aspect; the sign on the 4th is the target sign.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in Capricorn in the 10th (lagna Aries) aspects Cancer, the 4th, its own sign, a strong aspect.
Derived: Moon in Gemini in the 10th (lagna Virgo) aspects Sagittarius, the 4th.

classical_check: Agrees: every planet aspects the 7th house from itself.

hindi: 10थ हाउस का चंद्रमा वैद्य की तरह होता है।
says: Moon in the 10th is like a healer or physician, someone whose work is to serve and treat others.
cells_derived_method: 10th = profession; Moon as healer, nurse, caretaker work. Sign tilts the field.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon debilitated in Scorpio in the 10th (lagna Aquarius) - surgical or deep-treatment healing work.
Derived: Moon in own sign Cancer in the 10th (lagna Libra) - nursing, nutrition, care professions.

classical_check: Moon in 10th for public-serving professions is classical.

hindi: दवाई का काम कराना, दूसरे के काम आने वाला ऐसे व्यक्ति दूसरे के लिए बड़े अच्छे सलाहकार होते हैं।
says: Such people do medicine-related work, are useful to others and make very good advisors for other people.
cells_derived_method: Advisor and healer role; Mercury or Jupiter signs add advice skills.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in Gemini in the 10th (lagna Virgo) - advising and counselling through communication.
Derived: Moon in Sagittarius in the 10th (lagna Pisces) - guidance and teaching, advice rooted in values.

hindi: लेकिन यह शनि का घर है।
says: But the 10th is Saturn's house (Capricorn) which presses on the Moon.

hindi: भाव राशि 10 नंबर लेके चल रहे हैं।
says: He is using the house's natural sign number 10 (Capricorn) as the reference for the house.
ambiguity: Natural-zodiac sign for the 10th house, not the actual sign on the chart's 10th.
classical_check: Natural-zodiac method is classical; his use of it is explicit here.

hindi: शनि का भाव है।
says: The 10th is Saturn's bhava; the house itself carries Saturn's nature.

hindi: यह भाव वाली राशि की बात हो रही है।
says: Clarifies the talk is about the sign that belongs to the house, the house's natural sign, not the sign the Moon is in.
ambiguity: Could be confused with the actual sign; he separates 'house-sign' from 'planet-sign'.

hindi: राशि दो नंबर होगी तो अलग फल होगा।
says: If the sign (on the house) is number 2, Taurus, the result will be different from the Capricorn picture.
cells_derived_method: Moon in Taurus in the 10th (lagna Leo): exalted Moon on the 10th; career stable, comfort-linked.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon exalted in Taurus in the 10th (lagna Leo) - stable, resource-based profession; pressure of Saturn's house is softened.

ambiguity: Number 2 could be the Moon's sign in the 10th house.

hindi: तीन नंबर होगी अलग फल होगा।
says: With sign number 3, Gemini, again a different result.
cells_derived_method: Moon in Gemini in the 10th (lagna Virgo): mental work, communication, trade.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in Gemini in the 10th (lagna Virgo) - restless mind in the career house; many jobs or ideas.

hindi: लेकिन यहां किसी भी तरह का होगा तो यह दबा हुआ चंद्रमा है।
says: But in whatever form it appears, the Moon in the 10th is a pressed-down, suppressed Moon.
cells_derived_method: Pressure from the 10th house applies in all signs; the degree varies.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in Capricorn in the 10th (lagna Aries) - Saturn's own sign, maximum pressure on the mind.
Derived: Moon in own sign Cancer in the 10th (lagna Libra) - pressed but still resilient.

classical_check: Differs; classically Moon in 10th is often public and prominent, not suppressed.

hindi: यह भाव यह घर ऐसा है।
says: This house is built that way; the pressure is a property of the 10th house itself.

hindi: घर का वो कॉर्नर है।
says: The 10th is a corner of the house; the architecture image places it in a corner.
ambiguity: Likely a kendra (angle) remark, using a room-layout metaphor.

hindi: 12 कमरों का वो कमरा है जहां चंद्रमा दबा हुआ है।
says: Among the 12 rooms of the chart, this is the room where the Moon is squeezed.

hindi: तो मन थोड़ा दबा दबा सा रहेगा ऐसे व्यक्ति का हमेशा की तरह।
says: So the person's mind will remain a bit suppressed all the time.

hindi: तो ऐसा लगेगा मैं सारे टाइम घुटा हुआ हूं, घिरा हुआ हूं।
says: He will constantly feel suffocated and hemmed in, as if surrounded.
ambiguity: Psychological description, not a diagnosis.

gist: Rhetorical: what is the state of such a Moon?

hindi: पहाड़ों के बीच में घिरा हुआ पानी है।
says: Water image for the 10th-house Moon: water enclosed between mountains, as in a mountain lake or ravine.
ambiguity: Could be the remedy water source or only an image.

hindi: तो ऐसे चंद्रमा वाला व्यक्ति हमेशा ये सोच के चलेगा यार मैं पता नहीं कहां बंधा हुआ हूं यार।
says: Such a person always walks around thinking he is tied up somewhere he cannot name.

hindi: जिंदगी ना बंधी हुई है भाई।
says: Quoting the native: my whole life is tied down.

hindi: पता नहीं मेरे को यार बंधन ही खत्म नहीं होते।
says: Quoting the native: my bondages never seem to end.

hindi: मेरे को लगता है खाई में पड़ा हूं मैं।
says: Quoting the native: I feel I am lying in a gorge or pit, a trapped feeling.

hindi: वहां का पानी है।
says: The water for this case is the water of that gorge or ravine.

hindi: यह 11वा चंद्रमा है।
says: Now the Moon in the 11th house.

hindi: यह प्लूटो का घर है।
says: The 11th house is Pluto's house in his scheme (the Aquarius house).
ambiguity: Classically Aquarius belongs to Saturn; he gives Pluto as Aquarius's second lord.
classical_check: Differs from classical; modern outer-planet rulership.

hindi: राशि तुम्हें हमने दिखाने के लिए रखी है।
says: The sign shown is only a demonstration choice; the example sign was picked just to show.

hindi: दूसरी भी हो सकती है।
says: It could be another sign too; the house stays the same while the sign may differ.
ambiguity: Sentence starts at the end of the earlier chunk.

gist: Repeats that this is Pluto's house.

hindi: प्लूटो यमराज ट्रैप्ड।
says: Pluto is Yamraj (lord of death) and the Moon here is trapped in his domain.
ambiguity: 'Trapped' may refer to the Moon.
classical_check: Differs from classical; Pluto as Yama is his own scheme.

hindi: यह बरसाती नाले के पानी की तरह है।
says: The 11th-house Moon is like monsoon drain water, dirty runoff.

hindi: यानी कि आया तो आया साफ नहीं आया तो बेकार गंद ही घुलेगा।
says: Gains may come, but they come muddy: if the flow is not clean, only filth will mix in.
cells_derived_method: 11th = income and gains; Moon there brings uneven, soiled gains. Sign decides the cleanliness.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon exalted in Taurus in the 11th (lagna Cancer) - gains cleaner and steady.
Derived: Moon debilitated in Scorpio in the 11th (lagna Capricorn) - the muddy case, tainted gains.

classical_check: Differs; classically Moon in 11th is good for gains.

hindi: तो 11वें चंद्रमा वाले व्यक्ति के जीवन की जो उपलब्धियां होती हैं वो सब जगह कीचड़ फैलाने का काम करती है।
says: The achievements of a person with Moon in the 11th spread mud everywhere, giving more trouble than credit.
classical_check: Differs from classical views of 11th Moon.

hindi: सब जगह सत्यानाश बर्बादी।
says: Ruin and destruction everywhere is the end result he describes.
ambiguity: Rhetorical exaggeration.

hindi: यह 12वा चंद्रमा है।
says: Next case: Moon in the 12th house.

hindi: यह बर्फ का पानी जो ओस का पानी बरसात का पानी
says: The 12th-house water is the snow-melt, dew and rain type water, sky-derived water.

hindi: अगर यह दूषित हो तो ये पखाने का पानी है टॉयलेट का बरसात का पानी है
says: If that 12th-house water is polluted, it is toilet or sewage water mixed with rain, the afflicted form.
cells_derived_method: Afflicted-sign Moon gives the polluted water form: Scorpio or Capricorn worst; Cancer or Taurus cleaner.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon debilitated in Scorpio in the 12th (lagna Sagittarius) - polluted water form, afflicted case.
Derived: Moon in own sign Cancer in the 12th (lagna Leo) - clean snow or dew form.

hindi: 12वा घर खर्चे हॉस्पिटलाइजेशन मन में वहम रहता है।
says: The 12th house stands for expenses, hospitalisation and doubts in the mind.
cells_derived_method: 12th = loss, hospital, isolation, imagination; sign flavours the doubt.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: 12th house falling in Virgo (lagna Libra) - hospital stays and worry about small details.
Derived: 12th house in Pisces (lagna Aries) - imaginative doubts, expenses on spiritual matters.

classical_check: Agrees: 12th is vyaya and hospital house.

hindi: 12वा चंद्रमा वहमी बनाता है।
says: Moon in the 12th makes the native prone to illusions and suspicious thoughts.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in own sign Cancer in the 12th (lagna Leo) - worry directed at family security.
Derived: Moon debilitated in Scorpio in the 12th (lagna Sagittarius) - suspicion highest.

ambiguity: Psychological tendency, not a diagnosis.
classical_check: Classical: Moon in 12th gives expenses and mental unease; broadly agrees.

hindi: कोई भी राशि हो वह शक्की सोचते रहना।
says: Whatever the sign, the 12th-house Moon person stays suspicious and keeps brooding.
cells_derived_method: Sign changes the colour, not the presence, of the suspicion.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon exalted in Taurus in the 12th (lagna Gemini) - suspicion about money and comfort.
Derived: Moon in Gemini in the 12th (lagna Cancer) - talk-based, rumour-fed suspicion.

hindi: ऐसे बंदे दिन रात जोशियों के पास कुंडलियां लेके घूमते हैं।
says: Such people keep going to astrologers with their charts day and night, seeking reassurance.
ambiguity: Behavioural remark; could be a dig at clients.

hindi: छठे घर वाले भी घूमते हैं लेकिन वो रुक जाते हैं।
says: People with the Moon in the 6th house also wander about, but unlike others they stop and settle; the 6th-house Moon halts the restlessness.
cells_derived_method: 6th = service, routine, obstacles; Moon here wanders but gets held by duties. Sign shapes how long the wandering lasts.
