says: Planets enter the sign numbered four (Cancer) one by one, and he will describe each.

gist: Rhetorical 'how are they coming, brother?'
Board-writing remark: 'the 4 will have to be written somewhere'.
Repeats 'planets are coming into sign four'.
'The Sun has come' announcing the first planet in the sign.

hindi: अब हम बात हमने की थी चंद्रमा इनकी राशियों में गया तो क्या-क्या फल दे रहा है।
says: Earlier he studied what results the Moon gives when it goes into the other planets' signs; now he reverses it and puts other planets into the Moon's sign.

hindi: अब चंद्रमा का घर है चार नंबर।
says: The Moon's house (sign) is number four, which is Cancer.

hindi: जैसे एक रसोई है, एक बेडरूम है, एक किचन है, एक गेस्ट रूम है।
says: Analogy: a mansion has separate rooms such as kitchen, bedroom and guest room; each sign or house is like its own room with its own use.

gist: 'They are different, aren't they?'

hindi: ऐसे चार नंबर का जो एरिया है, 12 घरों में 12 कमरे की हवेली में चार नंबर का जो है वो चंद्रमा का है।
says: In a mansion of 12 rooms (the 12 signs) the room number four is the Moon's room; the sign Cancer is the Moon's area.
classical_check: Agrees on Moon lordship of Cancer.

gist: 'Where does this number four fall?'
'I wrote this for now' about the board number.

hindi: चार चौथे घर की बात नहीं हो रही।
says: He clarifies that the number four here is not the 4th house of the chart.
ambiguity: Resolves sign-versus-house ambiguity for this passage.

hindi: चार नंबर राशि की बात हो रही।
says: It is the sign number four (Cancer) being discussed, not the house; in this passage 'number' means sign.

hindi: चार नंबर में सूर्य आ गया।
says: Case one: the Sun is placed in sign four, Cancer.
cells_derived_method: Sun in Cancer in each house: the house topic receives the calm result he describes in the next sentences.
ambiguity: Introduction only; results follow.
classical_check: Sun in Cancer (a friend's sign) is classically an ordinary placement.

hindi: अब पानी है।
says: Cancer is water, the Moon's element.
classical_check: Cancer is a water sign: agrees.

gist: 'What did you do in the water?' rhetorical question.

hindi: गरम गरम तवा डाल दिया।
says: Analogy: the Sun is like a hot pan put into water.

hindi: ताप है।
says: The Sun stands for heat (tap), the quality that will burn the Moon's water.

gist: 'This is heat' repeated.

hindi: तो अभी तो तवे पर छींटे मारे वो तो [ __ ] के खत्म हो गए।
says: If water is sprinkled on a hot pan it vanishes; the Moon's water vanishes when it meets the Sun's heat.
ambiguity: Caption blank in the middle.

hindi: पांच नंबर का चंद्रमा तो सत्यानाश कर दिया उसने जहां बैठा है।
says: The Moon in sign number 5 (Leo, the Sun's sign) wrecks whatever house it sits in, like water on a hot pan.
cells_derived_method: Moon in Leo damages the topic of the house it occupies; house varies the area.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in Leo in the 4th (Taurus lagna); peace of mind and home life are the damaged topic.
Derived: Moon in Leo in the 7th; marriage and partnership are ruined under this reading.
Derived: Moon in Leo in the 10th; career honour is the damaged area, with ego flare.

ambiguity: 'पांच नंबर' is sign five on the basis of the passage.
classical_check: Differs: Moon in Leo is classically middling (Sun is a friend), not destructive.

hindi: जो सूर्य यहां पर आया तो इसने क्या किया?
says: Asks what the Sun does when it comes into Cancer; the answer follows.
ambiguity: Rhetorical question.

hindi: पानी को थोड़ा गर्म किया और खुद को शांत कर लिया।
says: The Sun in Cancer warms the water a little and itself becomes calm.
cells_derived_method: Sun in Cancer is cooled; its harshness softens in whichever house it sits.

hindi: यानी यहां पर सूर्य बहुत शांत फल देता है।
says: So the Sun in Cancer gives very calm results.
cells_derived_method: Sun in Cancer results are gentler than usual in any house.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun in the 1st in Cancer; soft, caring personality, less dominating.
Derived: Sun in the 10th in Cancer; authority exercised gently, nurturing leadership.

classical_check: Differs: classical texts do not describe Cancer Sun as calm.

hindi: चार नंबर का सूर्य हो गया।
says: This is now the Sun in sign four, Cancer: the placement under discussion.

hindi: यानी उस घर के अंदर सूर्य ने फूंकना नहीं है।
says: In that house the Sun will not scorch or burn.
cells_derived_method: Sun in Cancer does not burn the house topic where it sits.

hindi: सूर्य फूंकने का काम करता है।
says: The Sun's nature is to scorch (the general rule that Cancer modifies).
classical_check: Sun as a fiery malefic is classical.

hindi: जला देता है।
says: Normally the Sun burns what it touches.

hindi: तो सूर्य उसको फूंक नहीं पाएगा।
says: In Cancer the Sun cannot scorch the house; the water of Cancer protects it.

hindi: खुद भी थोड़ा सा शांत और शीतल हो जाएगा।
says: The Sun himself becomes calm and cool in Cancer.

hindi: यहां बैठा है।
says: The Sun sits here, in Cancer, and the following lines list what it gives.
ambiguity: Lead-in.

hindi: शांत शीतल धन देगा।
says: The Sun in Cancer gives wealth in a calm, cool way, without drama.
cells_derived_method: Wealth result applies to all houses; the house indicates the channel.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun in the 2nd in Cancer; steady family wealth and gentle speech.
Derived: Sun in the 11th in Cancer; calm, regular gains from networks.

hindi: शांत शीतल पराक्रम देगा।
says: It gives a quiet, cool kind of courage and initiative.
cells_derived_method: Courage result depends on house; strongest in the 3rd and 6th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun in the 3rd in Cancer; steady, unflashy courage and effort.
Derived: Sun in the 6th in Cancer; quiet strength against rivals.

hindi: शांत शीतल प्रॉपर्टी देगा।
says: It gives property in a calm way.
cells_derived_method: Property result is strongest when the Sun sits in the 4th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun in the 4th in Cancer; peaceful acquisition of home and land.

hindi: कोई लंबी तोप नहीं चलाएगा।
says: The Sun in Cancer will not fire big cannons, meaning it avoids boasting and large exaggerated claims.
ambiguity: Idiom; 'long cannon' means loud boasting.

hindi: शांत शीतल बच्चे देगा।
says: It gives calm, cool-natured children.
cells_derived_method: Children result is strongest when the Sun is in the 5th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun in the 5th in Cancer; gentle, well-behaved children.

classical_check: Differs: classical texts treat the Sun in the 5th as reducing children.

hindi: अगर डिग्री ज्यादा है तो जान से नहीं मारेगा।
says: If the Sun's degree is high, even then it will not kill; in Cancer it spares life.
ambiguity: 'Kill' refers to harm to a house topic or person (the son); not a death prediction rule.

hindi: अगर ये दो नंबर और सात नंबर का सूर्य यहां है मान लो तो जान से मार देता बेटा पैदा हो के।
says: If the Sun were in the 2nd or 7th instead, it would harm a son after the son is born; the contrast shows Cancer is the safer sign.
cells_derived_method: Sun in the 2nd or 7th is a danger to the son; in Cancer the effect is softened.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun in own sign in the 2nd; strong harm to the child indication under this reading.
Derived: Sun exalted in the 7th in Aries; harsh effect on partnership and child, as per this reading.

ambiguity: 'दो नंबर और सात नंबर' could be signs 2 and 7 or houses 2 and 7; houses read here. A death-type claim, recorded only as his words.
classical_check: Differs: classically Sun in 7 hurts marriage; harm to a son is not standard for 2 and 7.

hindi: विशेष तौर पर बेटे को मारता है।
says: He says the Sun in those placements specifically harms the son (a claim recorded as his words, not a prediction).
ambiguity: Death-type claim; not usable as a prediction.

hindi: यहां आए तो शांत रूप से शत्रु आएंगे।
says: With the Sun in Cancer, enemies will come in a calm, non-aggressive form.
cells_derived_method: Enemy result is strongest when the Sun is in the 6th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun in the 6th in Cancer; opponents who come quietly and are overcome.

hindi: लेकिन सूर्य देवता है।
says: But the Sun is a god (deity) and carries divine power despite being calm.

hindi: सबसे बड़ा भगवान है।
says: The Sun is the greatest of the gods in his view.

hindi: शत्रु टिक नहीं सकते इसके आगे।
says: Enemies cannot stand before the Sun, even a calm Sun in Cancer.

hindi: शत्रु हंता योग है।
says: Sun in Cancer forms an enemy-destroying yoga (shatru-hanta yoga).
cells_derived_method: Enemy destroying result is strongest in the 6th house and also in other houses where rivals are met.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun in the 6th in Cancer; clear victory over rivals.
Derived: Sun in the 10th in Cancer; workplace rivals fail.

ambiguity: 'Shatru hanta' is not a named yoga in standard texts.

hindi: मार देता है।
says: It kills (finishes off) the enemies.
ambiguity: Figurative.

gist: 'Finished, enemy finished', emphasis on the previous line.
'In such a situation it will be here', filler leading into the marriage point.

hindi: सूर्य सारी जिंदगी पतिपत्नी में फ्रिक्शन रहेगी।
says: With the Sun in Cancer there will be friction between husband and wife throughout life.
cells_derived_method: Marriage friction is strongest when the Sun is in the 7th or 2nd.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun in the 7th in Cancer; friction in marriage is lifelong but the pair stays together.
Derived: Sun in the 1st in Cancer; the native's own temperament creates the friction.

ambiguity: Applies to all houses or only 7th is not stated.
classical_check: Sun in the 7th is a classical marriage affliction; for other houses it is his extension.

hindi: तलाक नहीं होगा।
says: But no divorce will happen with this placement.
ambiguity: A definite non-divorce claim; sign alone cannot guarantee this.

hindi: रो पिट के घसीटेंगे।
says: The couple will drag the marriage along with crying and fighting.

hindi: चार नंबर के सूर्य का यहां ये दोष है।
says: This is the defect of the Sun in sign four: lifelong marital friction.

hindi: तलाक ही हो जाए।
says: He says it could end up in divorce for someone (the alternative to dragging on).
ambiguity: Unclear whether he is voicing a couple's wish or saying a divorce may happen; contradicts 'no divorce' two lines earlier.

hindi: इससे तो काम खत्म।
says: With divorce the matter would be finished; he sets it against dragging on.

hindi: ऐसे में सूर्य यहां होगा।
says: Transition: with the Sun placed here, the following lines on death follow.

hindi: मौत को आसानी से आने नहीं देगा।
says: The Sun in Cancer will not let death come easily: a hard death is claimed. This is a death-type claim, recorded only as his words.
ambiguity: Not to be used as a death prediction.

hindi: शांति से आएगी।
says: Death will come peacefully; so the Sun in Cancer is said to give a peaceful end after a delay. Recorded as his words, not a prediction.
ambiguity: Death-type claim; not usable.

hindi: प्लूटो प्लूटो होता है ना मृत्यु का देवता
says: Pluto is the god of death in his 12-planet scheme (Yama).

hindi: सूर्य जीवन का देवता है एक जीवन है ऊर्जा
says: The Sun is the god of life, life and energy itself, the opposite of Pluto's death.
classical_check: Sun as prana karaka is classical.

hindi: यहां प्लूटो बैठा तो क्या करेगा मरने नहीं देगा आसानी से
says: Pluto in Cancer (or with the Sun there) would not let a person die easily: he restates the hard-death idea for Pluto. Recorded only as his words.
ambiguity: Unclear whether Pluto sits in Cancer with the Sun or this is a separate case; death-type claim, not a prediction.

hindi: यह धर्म चलवाएगा यहां कार्य चलाएगा ठेकेदार बनाता है
says: In this setting Pluto runs religious and public works and makes the person a contractor.
cells_derived_method: Contractor and religious-work result is strongest when Pluto sits in the 10th or 4th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Pluto in the 10th in Cancer; public building and contract work as career.
Derived: Pluto in the 4th in Cancer; construction around home and land.

hindi: मजे की बात बिल्डिंग का ठेका दारू का ठेका दोनों इसके पास होते हैं बहुत मजेदार है
says: Funny point: both the building contract and the liquor contract go to this person (building and alcohol both under Pluto in Cancer).

hindi: राशियों का फर्क होता है
says: Results differ by sign: the same planet gives different results in different signs.

hindi: यह लाभ का ग्रह यात्रा का ये विदेश का साधु संत ज्ञान सब कुछ
says: This planet (Pluto in his view) governs gains, travel, foreign lands, sadhus, saints and knowledge, all of it.
ambiguity: Planet not clearly named; could be the Sun.

hindi: सूर्य लेकिन ठंडा ठंडा ठंडा ठंडा चलेगा
says: But the Sun here will run cold, cool and calm, because it is in a water sign.

hindi: ठंडा तवा है ऐसा मान के चले इसको इस प्रकार से
says: Treat the Sun in Cancer as a cold pan: a rule-of-thumb image for reading it.

gist: 'Now the Sun has come' marking the end of the Sun case.

hindi: उसके बाद यहां राहु महाराज चार नंबर में सूर्य लिया हमने।
says: After the Sun, Rahu is the next planet to be placed in sign four; the Sun case is done.
ambiguity: Order in the lecture is Sun, Rahu, Moon, Mars.

hindi: अब चंद्रमा तो खैर अच्छा है ही।
says: The Moon in its own sign Cancer is of course good.
cells_derived_method: Moon in own sign Cancer is strong in any house.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in own sign in the 4th; mother and home are the strong topic.
Derived: Moon in own sign in the 10th; public popularity and a nurturing career.

hindi: अब मंगल ले लेते हैं यहां।
says: Next, take Mars into sign four.

hindi: यह हमारा चार नंबर का मंगल आ गया।
says: This is our Mars in sign four, which is Cancer, Mars's sign of debilitation.
ambiguity: He does not say it is debilitated here; this is the standard table (Mars is debilitated in Cancer).
classical_check: Mars debilitated in Cancer is classical.

gist: Rhetorical question 'what is Mars?'

hindi: आग।
says: Mars is fire; he states the nature of Mars before joining it with the water sign.
ambiguity: One-word answer.

hindi: आप आग को पानी में डालेंगे।
says: Putting Mars (fire) into Cancer (water) is like throwing fire into water; he opens the Mars-in-Cancer case with this image.
cells_derived_method: Mars in Cancer is a fire-in-water clash; the house it falls in carries the clash.
classical_check: Mars in Cancer is debilitated classically; consistent in direction.

gist: 'What will you do?' rhetorical question.

hindi: नष्ट कर देगा वो उस पानी को।
says: The fire (Mars) destroys that water (the Moon's sign): in Cancer, Mars ruins the water quality of the sign and of the house topic.
cells_derived_method: Mars's damage to Cancer water shows in the house topic it sits in.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in the 4th in Cancer (Aries lagna); peace at home and mother's comfort are damaged.
Derived: Mars in the 10th in Cancer (Libra lagna); career feelings and public support get burned.

classical_check: Agrees in direction with Mars debilitated in Cancer.

hindi: वो पानी किसी लायक नहीं रहेगा।
says: The water will not be usable for anything after Mars is in it; the house is left useless for its normal purpose.

hindi: कैसे हो सकता है कि आप आग और पानी को मिलाएं।
says: How can you mix fire and water? The two cannot be combined; the blend itself is impossible, so one destroys the other.

gist: 'It will destroy' repeated.

hindi: यही हमारे यहां वास्तु में दोष होता है कि पानी आप पानी का एरिया डाल दिया।
says: The same logic is the Vastu fault: putting a water area (tank, bore, water feature) where fire should be.
ambiguity: Direction named in the next line.
classical_check: Vastu is a separate system; the water-in-fire-corner prohibition is standard vastu.

hindi: साउथ ईस्ट में आपने पैसा आना बंद हो जाएगा।
says: Water in the south-east (the fire corner) will stop money coming in: a vastu link between the fire-water clash and finances.
ambiguity: Financial outcome claimed; not advice.
classical_check: South-east as Agni corner is standard vastu; the money effect is a vastu claim.

hindi: तो मंगल चार नंबर का जहां बैठा है कुछ स्पेसिफिक केस को छोड़ के वो नष्ट कर देता है।
says: Mars in sign number four ruins whichever house it sits in, apart from a few specific exceptions.
cells_derived_method: Mars in Cancer damages the topic of its house; the exceptions he starts listing later (4th with business rise, 2nd).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in the 7th in Cancer (Capricorn lagna); partnership suffers, with a manglik-type clash.
Derived: Mars in the 5th in Cancer (Pisces lagna); children and creative output suffer.

ambiguity: The 'specific cases' are not listed at once.
classical_check: Debilitated Mars in a house harming its topic is standard.

hindi: कट लगाता है।
says: Mars in Cancer inflicts cuts: a cutting effect on the house topic and the body part.
classical_check: Mars as cuts and surgery is classical.

hindi: चाकू से कट लगाएगा तो चाकू से डॉक्टर आपकी सर्जरी करेगा।
says: Mars cuts with a knife and the doctor also uses a knife for surgery; the same Mars can turn into surgical work.
classical_check: Mars as surgeon karaka is classical.

hindi: जहां पर भी बैठा है मंगल बैड है।
says: Wherever Mars sits (in this sign) it is bad for that house.

hindi: इसकी एक पॉजिटिविटी बहुत कमाल है।
says: Yet one positive feature of this placement is outstanding, explained in the next lines.
ambiguity: Lead-in.

hindi: क्योंकि मंगल के यहां दूसरे सामने जहां भी जहां भी होगा उच्च दृष्टि है।
says: The positive is that Mars in Cancer looks across at the opposite sign, which is Capricorn, its exaltation sign, so its aspect falls on an exalted position wherever that is.
cells_derived_method: Mars in Cancer in house H casts a 7th aspect on house H+6 (Capricorn); the house topic opposite gets strengthened.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in the 1st in Cancer (Cancer lagna) aspects the 7th in Capricorn; partnerships get Mars energy.
Derived: Mars in the 4th in Cancer (Aries lagna) aspects the 10th in Capricorn; career gets strong drive.

ambiguity: 'Opposite' is the 7th aspect to Capricorn; Capricorn as exalted sign is from the standard table.
classical_check: 7th aspect is classical; 'exalted aspect' as a concept is his own.

hindi: कृष्ण जी का मंगल यहां बैठा हुआ था और यहां एक नंबर पर पूर्ण दृष्टि थी।
says: Krishna's Mars sat here (in Cancer) and had a full aspect on number one (a sign or house; unclear).
ambiguity: 'एक नंबर' could be sign Aries or the 1st house; Mars in Cancer does not aspect Aries by the 4th, 7th or 8th aspects, so the claim does not fit the usual aspects.
classical_check: Differs from standard Mars aspects (4th, 7th, 8th from its position).

hindi: भगवान बना दिया।
says: That aspect made Krishna a god: the Mars aspect on an exalted spot is said to give divine stature.

hindi: तो मंगल की जहां उच्च दृष्टि है भगवान बना देता है।
says: Wherever Mars has this exalted aspect it can raise a person to godlike status.
ambiguity: Exaggeration; generalisation from the Krishna example.

hindi: हनुमान है ना भगवान के काम भी राम काज कई बेको आते हो।
says: Hanuman is another example of a Mars figure who does the work of God (Ram's work); the caption tail is garbled.
ambiguity: Caption tail 'कई बेको आते हो' is unreadable.
classical_check: Hanuman as Mars deity is traditional.

gist: 'What will this do now?' rhetorical lead-in.

hindi: मंगल यहां तो कट लगा देगा।
says: Mars here in Cancer will cut the house it sits in.

hindi: दूसरी जगह रॉकेट बना देगा।
says: At another place (the aspected house) Mars will make the topic fly like a rocket.
cells_derived_method: The aspected house gets a sudden rise.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in the 4th in Cancer aspects the 10th in Capricorn (Aries lagna); career climbs steeply.

hindi: ऐसे व्यक्ति का मान लो यहां मंगल बैठा है।
says: Take a person who has Mars sitting here (in the 4th house in Cancer, as he points on the chart).
ambiguity: House inferred from the next sentences (4th house).

hindi: उसके हाथ पे कट लगा प्लास्टर चढ़ा।
says: Such a person has had a cut and a plaster cast on the hand: an injury illustration.
ambiguity: Injury example; not a rule to use for health.

gist: 'Let us talk about this house' moving on.

hindi: चौथे में बैठा है तो हड्डी तोड़ देगा यहां की।
says: Mars sitting in the 4th will break a bone, in the part of the body or area of life tied to this house.
cells_derived_method: Mars in the 4th in Cancer (Aries lagna): the 4th is chest and home; the bone claim is a body-part reading.
ambiguity: Injury claim; recorded as his words, not a medical rule.
classical_check: Mars in the 4th is a classical affliction of home peace.

hindi: नहीं तो कट लगाएगा।
says: Otherwise Mars in the 4th will cut (instead of breaking the bone).

hindi: हड्डी तोड़ना शनि का काम है।
says: Breaking bones is Saturn's job; Mars cuts, Saturn breaks.
ambiguity: Contradicts the earlier line where Mars breaks a bone.
classical_check: Saturn as bones is classical; Mars is blood and muscle but also fractures.

gist: 'It will make a cut' repeated.

hindi: इसको लाजवाब कॉम्बिनेशन है।
says: This pair (Mars in Cancer with Moon aspecting from the opposite side) is a splendid combination.

hindi: अगर शनि होता वहां तो प्रबल धनवान योग अंधा पैसा होता है जिसकी कुंडली में मंगल शनि एक दूसरे को देखते हैं।
